text: Omer Yousaf holds account PK**MUCB****9220 which was opened on 19 July 2023. The subject declares a student occupation and a monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 3 March 2026 and 12 March 2026 the account received 29 credits totalling PKR 1,392,000 and made 6 debits totalling PKR 1,204,000. All 29 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers originating from 24 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 12 March 2026, scoring a MULE-01 typology of 360 against a threshold of 300. Taken together, these patterns are indicative of suspected money mule activity. PKR 831,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 4 transactions. PKR 373,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. Screening on 30 March 2026 found no matches on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer.
